hypotheses.paper: M a singular flat spacetime; X from lem:vecteur
hypotheses.note: only the 'Moreover' (M homeomorphic to Sigma x R) is addressed, for an abstract causal flow; lem:vecteur's field and completeness are not built

findings: ETT.tex:1792: 'Since X is non-singular, psi is a local diffeomorphism' needs Sigma a smooth hypersurface transverse to X; a Cauchy surface (def:cauchy_surface) is only a set. The topological replacement is continuity of the hitting time, which is EQUIVALENT to J^+(Sigma), J^-(Sigma) closed (IsCausalFlow.isClosed_iff_exists_isCauchySplitting). lem:Sigma_separe (ETT.tex:2062) derives that closedness FROM the splitting, so it cannot be used here. Where the flow is chronal it follows (isClosed_Jplus/Jminus). For a NON-chronal flow (gx's E0, time translation along a BTZ line) the flow criterion isClosed_Jplus_of_nhds cannot discharge it: it needs J^-(phi eps p) in nhds p at EVERY p outside J^+(Sigma), and at a BTZ point below Sigma that set is a half-line of the singular line. IsClosed (J^+-(Sigma)) is then a whole-model obligation; the flow-free criteria isClosed_Jplus_of_forall_exists(_lt) reduce it to finding, at each p outside J^+(Sigma), SOME r outside J^+(Sigma) with J^-(r) in nhds p (e.g. a regular r with p << r), which is the form a model with BTZ lines can try.

ETT.tex:1794-1795: 'They therefore meet Sigma exactly once. Hence psi is bijective' also needs the orbits not to be periodic; here it follows from causality and the absence of stationary points (IsCausalFlow.eq_zero_of_apply_eq).

kb_proposals: A causal flow splits M along an acausal Cauchy surface S iff J^+-(S) are closed; the inverse is p -> (phi tau(p) p, -tau(p)) with tau the hitting time, continuous because {tau > a} = (phi a)^-1 (J^+(S))^c. Chronal orbits make J^+-(S) closed for free (I^-(phi eps p) is an open neighbourhood of p).

J^+_U(S cap U) \ S = I^+_U(S cap U) needs a chronal thread through each point; it fails at any point with empty chronological past (BTZ points): on the lightlike line every other hypothesis of Jplus_diff_eq_Iplus holds, {0} Cauchy included (lightlikeLine_Jplus_diff_ne_Iplus), yet the sides are open (lightlikeLine_twoSided_of_pointwise).
mathlib Flow R M works directly with the library's curves: (fun t => phi t x) is the orbit; Flow.map_add / map_zero_apply; Flow.continuous for joint continuity; the reverse flow gives C.dual.
CausalScaffold.CompactCauchy has no .olean at this commit; a file that must stay buildable with lake env lean cannot import it - state the unfolded body instead.

Two causalities with the same le have the same causal curves, extensions and inextensible curves, but not definitionally at the type level (CausalCurveIn/StrictlyExtends are structures parameterised by C): transfer field by field (lightlikeLine_isCauchySurface_zero).

Inextensibility of flow orbits needs no time function: if an orbit of a continuous flow (T2) converged at an end it would converge to a fixed point; so orbits of a fixed-point-free flow that are causal curves over R are inextensible (Causality.inextensible_of_flow, the extension's sup/inf of the reparametrisation is the limit point).

A (G,X)-manifold over Minkowski with G = isom d is a mathlib smooth manifold (gxGroupoid <= contDiffGroupoid, groupoid_of_pregroupoid_le); tangent coordinates: tangentCoordChange I x y z is the linear part of the local isometry (HasFDerivAt.unique against hasFDerivWithinAt_tangentCoordChange); a convex fibrewise condition invariant under those linear parts glues by exists_contMDiffSection_forall_mem_convex_of_local with local section y -> tangentCoordChange I x0 y y e0 (constant e0 in the trivialization at x0).

Chronality from velocity without C1: a curve with a future timelike derivative at every point of [s,s'] has a future timelike chord, by the functional l v = v.1 - <u, v.2> (u the chord's spatial direction) and strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos; no continuity of the derivative needed.

Global flow of a vector field on a manifold at this pin (fabf563a), no maximal curves needed: (1) locally finite cover by chart balls with a uniform inner margin = refinement_of_locallyCompact_sigmaCompact_of_nhds_basis_set (basis chart⁻¹ ball ∩ source, closedBall ⊆ target) + exists_subset_iUnion_closed_subset + IsCompact.exists_cthickening_subset_open; (2) f = positive smooth function with f ≤ δ_j/(2(M_j+1)) on ball j via exists_contMDiffMap_forall_mem_convex_of_local_const (constraint {s | 0 < s ∧ ∀ j, y ∈ O j → s ≤ β j}, local constant from local finiteness); (3) IsPicardLindelof.of_time_independent on [-1,1] with a = δ, r = L = δ/2 in every chart; mathlib's local-flow theorem drops the confinement α(x,t) ∈ closedBall x₀ a, so re-prove it from ODE.FunSpace (compProj_mem_closedBall); (4) transport back = the second half of mathlib's exists_isMIntegralCurveAt_of_contMDiffAt (needs set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false); (5) exists_isMIntegralCurve_of_isMIntegralCurveOn (uniform time 1), continuity near |t| < 1 by isMIntegralCurveOn_Ioo_eqOn_of_contMDiff_boundaryless, all t by Φ t = Φ (t/2) ∘ Φ (t/2) and induction on |t| < 2^m.
